E2: idle for 6 s: no AudioContext, no music event
E3: the first touch made one AudioContext, inside the activation (touchend)
E3: the contact note was struck while locked and re-struck audibly at the tap (one heard note, in key)
E5: a first-touch hold starts the hum's visuals (padOn) and never bursts after lift (≤ 1 heard note, no heard hum)
E4: the note sounds at contact (heard, immediate, ≤ 6 ms added) before the finger lifts
E6 hold: one contact note, then the hum (padOn from it), a held pad voice, released on lift
E6 press down: duck, then bassOn (no second strike), a held bass voice, bassOff on lift
E6 wheel: a bass that ends as the wheel settles
E6 stroke: ≥ 3 phrase notes after the first, each on the grid (±3 ms), and a phraseEnd
E6 double tap: the second note rolls into a chord (2 more notes, on 16ths)
E6 drag up: the note becomes a held glide (keep) that bends, then snaps
E6: every voice is gone ≤ 3.5 s after the last release
E6 pinch: the first finger's note ducks under the bass; the bass ends on lift
